scope: heuristic contextual retrieval on licensed development sources; not human gold, not independent holdout
method: Deterministic hash sample, max one per document per pattern, source context kept private; surface hits are candidates, not confirmed discourse/grammatical categories.

failed_attempt.reason: Archive includes large nontext assets; original 100 MB cap exceeded. Bounded stream fixed without extracting media.

review_scope: AI reading of all 126 focus windows and available surrounding context (some context displayed in shortened form); not article-by-article reading of the entire corpus, not independent human review. Retrieval matches are provisional, not quality labels. No source excerpts published.

findings.decision: Question introduces a genuine unresolved issue; next material must answer it.
Reformulation may clarify an implication, correct a misunderstanding, or turn abstract terminology into a practical question; redundant reformulations still removable.
Contrast may introduce a prerequisite, extend the stated scope, or limit applicability; distinguish these functions rather than banning markers.
Example can instantiate a calculation or illustrate a hypothetical procedure. Keep the hypothetical or empirical status.
Result markers can express a procedure outcome, causal justification, or completed exposition; require the relevant relation in the source.
Temporal order, condition, and modality must survive converb edits; a shared predicate does not justify collapsing different agents.
Nominalization may identify a specific operation and its completion; simplify only when redundant support verbs and nominal chains obscure the actual action.
Verb case frames carry meaning, e.g. direction, source, object, and location. Check inflection together with lexical choice. Annotation anomalies require caution.
Author stance markers can preserve uncertainty, subjectivity, preference and personal narrative; don't standardize them into assertions.
